text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami? Are you feverish? Have you
eaten
anything strange recently?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
N-no! I didn't eat at all! I'm actually
starving right
now!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I've been too busy making this really big
cake for
your special day—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Please, forget everything I just said! If
you know
about the surprise, it won't be
a surprise!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh nooo! I wanted to be all elegant like you and lead you to it discreetly, but I ruined it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So you revealed a little surprise or
two—why
would I be disappointed by
that?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You made such an effort to celebrate my

birthday... That's the most wonderful
surprise of
all.
